unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.label: Password name
unlock.label_hint: Distinguishes multiple passwords, e.g. Work, Personal
unlock.pick_folder_hint: Unlock parameters live in the files, so pick a folder before typing a password
unlock.quick_hint: Enter a password to unlock encrypted files in this folder

encrypt.label: Password name
encrypt.filename_keep_ext_desc: Easier to identify, but reveals the file format
encrypt.compress_desc: Helps text and documents a lot, barely affects already-compressed media
encrypt.strength_sensitive_desc: 1 GiB · about 2 s, heavy on mobile
encrypt.original_delete_desc: Cannot be undone, and complete erasure is not guaranteed
encrypt.no_erase_note: This app does not offer "secure erase". SSD wear leveling makes overwrite-based erasure unreliable, and offering it would give a false sense of security.
encrypt.folder_note: Folder encryption is not implemented yet; selected folders will be skipped.

playback.cannot_preview: This format cannot be previewed in the app

view.empty_hint: Pick a place on the left to start browsing
view.start_hint: Browse files freely and encrypt what you select; double-click an encrypted file and enter its password to view it
view.name: Name

device.title: Devices & sharing
device.store_explain: The device store password protects this device's identity and its paired-device list. It is not the password for your encrypted files. Set one on first use.
device.fingerprint_hint: When pairing, check that both devices show the same fingerprints. A mismatch means someone is in the middle.
device.none_found: No devices found. Check that the other device is sharing and on the same network.
device.name_untrusted: Device names come from the other device's broadcast and cannot be trusted. Go by the fingerprint.
device.enter_pin: Pairing code shown on the other device
device.pin_hint: On the other device choose "Pair a device", enter this machine's address and port {{port}}, then type the code above. The code is valid for 2 minutes.
device.verify_hint: Confirm the other device shows these same two fingerprints.
device.share_no_password: Sharing does not need your file password: this device only sends ciphertext, and decryption happens on the other device. They still need the password to see anything.
device.share_no_peer: No devices paired yet, so nobody can connect.

remote.empty: This device is not sharing any files
remote.empty_hint: Ask them to pick a folder to share on their device.

errors.load_failed: Can't open this location. It may not exist or be readable.
